statements.t: Our company is a targeted healthcare holding company dedicated to acquiring and building middle-market niche healthcare clinics, primarily in orthopedics, spine care, and pain management.
Management does not currently have any plans to develop this property and expects to eventually sell the property.

As of September 30, 2026, we had two reportable operating segments as determined by management using the “management approach” as defined by the authoritative guidance on Disclosures about Segments of an Enterprise and Related Information .
However, there can be no assurance that we will be able to obtain sufficient capital from debt or equity transactions or from operations in the necessary time frame or on terms acceptable to us.
No assurance can be given that we will be able to operate profitably on a consistent basis, or at all, in the future.
When presented with a lower amount we will discuss the reasons for the reduced rate and negotiate a higher rate.
Shortening our negotiation time frame will typically result in a lower settlement realization rate, but will accelerate the cash settlement of the outstanding accounts receivable.
